info.title: TerraScale Platform
info.description:
Public routes work without an authorization token in Scalar.

To call protected routes, use the Bearer auth panel and paste an access token
returned by one of TerraScale's login flows, for example:

- `POST /api/v1/auth/password/login`
- `POST /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/auth/login`
- `POST /api/v1/projects/{projectId}/auth/m2m/token`

The responses include an `access_token` value that you can copy into Scalar.

AdminAuditEventResponse.description:
Admin view of an audit event. Matches the SDK `AuditEvent` shape.
The platform audit log is sourced from ProjectAuditEvent
records across every project; the underlying Risk/Source fields are
surfaced through JsonElement? AdminAuditEventResponse.Metadata.

AdminCreateSupportNoteRequest.description:
Admin request to create a support note. Matches the SDK
`AdminCreateSupportNoteRequest` shape (the note body plus the optional
resource the note is attached to).

AdminDatabaseEnvironmentResponse.description: Admin view of a database environment. Matches the SDK `DatabaseEnvironment` shape.

AdminDatabaseResponse.description:
Admin view of a project database. Matches the SDK `ProjectDatabase` shape.
Environments are empty in the platform-wide list to keep the query cheap; the
per-database detail surface stays with the project-scoped endpoints.

AdminNotificationResponse.description:
Admin view of a user notification. Matches the SDK `Notification` shape
(`notificationId`, `userId`, `title`, `body`, `severity`,
`readAt`, `createdAt`). Platform-wide notifications today are the
inbox items raised for any user.

AdminOrganizationResponse.description: Admin view of an organization. Matches the SDK `Organization` shape.

AdminProjectResponse.description: Admin view of a project. Matches the SDK `Project` shape.

AdminSupportNoteResponse.description:
Admin view of a support note. Matches the SDK `AdminSupportNote` shape
(`supportNoteId`, `userId`, `organizationId`, `projectId`,
`note`, `createdAt`).

AdminUserResponse.description:
Platform-wide admin view of a TerraScale user. Matches the SDK
`AdminUser` shape (`userId`, `email`, `displayName`,
`enabled`, `owner`, `organizationIds`, `createdAt`).

ErrorCategory.description: Error categories for the TerraScale Database.

message.description: Human-readable description of the validation failure.

FieldError.description: A validation error on a specific field.

backupRegion.description:
The single customer-selected region responsible for project backups.
This region is always one of List<string> Project.Regions.

placementRegions.description:
Durable transition mesh. During region removal this is the union of
prior and desired regions until every removed cell completes its drain.

backupCoordinatorRegion.description:
Selected regional cell that exclusively owns TerraBase backup tasks and
restore orchestration for the current placement generation. Backup APIs
fail closed until this ownership is durably provisioned.

storageRequired.description: False means a newly created project has no physical tenant database yet.

nextCursor.description: Opaque project-bound continuation cursor. It expires shortly; reload after a 409 response.

code.description:
Machine-readable error code (e.g., "TERRASCALE-1001").
SDK clients should switch on this code for programmatic error handling.

message.description: Human-readable error message suitable for display.

category.description: Error category for grouping related errors.

detail.description: Additional context about the error (field names, limits, etc.).

suggestedAction.description: Suggested action to resolve the error.

traceId.description: Request-scoped trace ID for support correlation.

TerraScaleError.description: Structured error with machine-readable code, human-readable message, and actionable guidance.

TerraScaleErrorResponse.description:
Standardized API error response envelope.
All TerraScale Database errors use this shape for consistency across endpoints and SDKs.
